assertion.statement: Geometric supersingular cyclic-level pairs form B*\Bhat*/Rhat*, with endomorphism ring R_z=B intersect zRhat z^-1 and automorphism group R_z*.
assertion.objects: Enhanced curves E=(A,C), fixed E0, Eichler order R, right module I=Hom(E0,E), coordinate z.
assertion.hypotheses: Ribet Section3 hypotheses and geometric category over algebraic closure F_q; Prop3.6 realizes an initially chosen Eichler order as the reference endomorphism ring.
assertion.quantifiers: Every geometric enhanced pair and every reference Eichler order of the stated level.
assertion.parameter_range: q=ell_0 odd prime; all positive N coprime to q, with arbitrary prime-power exponents including2; choose auxiliary p outside Nq.
assertion.uniformity: Exact geometric classification and actions; no asymptotic bound or discriminant size condition.
assertion.constants: No class-number or automorphism quotient factor is inserted; Frobenius has order dividing2 on the coarse set.
assertion.normalizations: Ihat=zRhat; rational quasi-isogeny changes z on left; integral basis changes it on right. Endomorphisms act on I on the left.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Do not divide labelled embeddings by the field normalizer; no squarefree level or scalar elliptic model is assumed.
assertion.limit_order: Choose auxiliary p, then reference E0 and rational identifications, then the class-set coordinate.

assertion.statement: Prime-to-q ideal quotients correspond to the same adelic lattice multiplication, with one uniform inverse ideal convention.
assertion.objects: Enhanced prime-to-q Tate lattices, covariant q-Dieudonne convention, right Hom module, CM ideal a prime to Nq.
assertion.hypotheses: The quotient and its endomorphisms exist by retained good-reduction facts; source geometric/Tate classification and O action are fixed.
assertion.quantifiers: Every prime-to-Nq ideal representative and every prime component of the fixed reference realization.
assertion.parameter_range: q=ell_0 odd prime; all positive N coprime to q, with arbitrary prime-power exponents including2; choose auxiliary p outside Nq.
assertion.uniformity: Exact geometric classification and actions; no asymptotic bound or discriminant size condition.
assertion.constants: No class-number or automorphism quotient factor is inserted; Frobenius has order dividing2 on the coarse set.
assertion.normalizations: At l!=q use usual Tate modules; at q use Ribet transpose of contravariant Dieudonne module. Quotient replaces Lambda_l by a_l^-1 Lambda_l, hence z by a^-1 z.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Do not use an etale rank-two q-adic Tate module; do not conflate a transporter with its inverse. No source claim supplies quotient-specialization existence.
assertion.limit_order: Construct the ideal quotient using retained inputs, then compare its lattices in the same rational identification.

assertion.statement: Every supersingular geometric coarse modular point is F_(q^2)-rational; a parametrization overF_q sends it into E(F_(q^2)), so one lambda_M evaluates all terms.
assertion.objects: The finite-type coarse scheme X0(N)/F_q, closed-point residue field, Frobenius orbit, rational modular parametrization.
assertion.hypotheses: Ribet Frobenius is involutive on its geometric supersingular point set; the parametrization extends overF_q by retained good-reduction input.
assertion.quantifiers: Every supersingular geometric coarse point and every corresponding parametrization value used in the finite character sum.
assertion.parameter_range: q=ell_0 odd prime; all positive N coprime to q, with arbitrary prime-power exponents including2; choose auxiliary p outside Nq.
assertion.uniformity: Exact geometric classification and actions; no asymptotic bound or discriminant size condition.
assertion.constants: No class-number or automorphism quotient factor is inserted; Frobenius has order dividing2 on the coarse set.
assertion.normalizations: Closed-point degree equals Frobenius orbit length; fixed by square implies degree divides2. This is descent of a coarse scheme point.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No descent of all labelled moduli objects, isogenies or embeddings; no scalar-Frobenius elliptic model is concluded or needed.
assertion.limit_order: Use geometric classification and involution, deduce residue degree, then apply the F_q morphism and lambda_M.
